name: Interleaved
summary: Left and right eye views interleaved at the pixel or row level within a single frame. The display's polarisation filter physically separates the views to each eye. Used by passive 3D monitors (row interleaved) and some checkerboard displays.

variants.name: Row Interleaved
variants.description: Odd rows contain the left eye view, even rows the right (or vice versa). Standard format for passive 3D monitors. Half vertical resolution per eye.

variants.name: Column Interleaved
variants.description: Alternating columns for each eye. Less common than row. Used by some auto-stereoscopic displays.

variants.name: Checkerboard
variants.description: Pixels alternate in a checkerboard pattern between eyes. Used by some DLP projectors and displays. Half resolution per eye in both axes.
